animations.label: Idle
animations.description: Generate a 1536x1024 transparent sprite atlas with exactly SIX sequential animation frames arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, read left-to-right then next row. Each complete pose isolated inside its own 512x512 cell, at consistent scale ~360px horse/rider length, ample transparent margins including full sword, fixed saddle position. Preserve approved reference identity EXACTLY: Russian Napoleonic cuirassier, black cuirass, white jacket with red cuffs, brass shoulder scales, black crested helmet, white gloves, pale trousers and black tall boots, bay horse without armor, red edged saddlecloth, pale saddle roll. Direct overhead camera with helmet crown visible, facing screen-bottom, horse tail top. Right hand SCREEN LEFT carries rigid STRAIGHT steel cavalry broadsword with brass basket guard; left hand SCREEN RIGHT reins. No shield or extra weapons. Match reference smooth painterly finish, palette and lighting, no grain or bold outlines. Transparent background, no glow/shadows/text/grid lines. Six coherent consecutive poses for: Quiet breathing idle loop. Nearly fixed rider, horse head and feet, only slight chest breathing, subtle ears and tail. No sway or stepping.
